description: Come on in out of the cold, friend. I'm Gus, and there's always a spare chair by the woodstove. From frozen pipes to forty below on a dark January morning, I'm bringing thirty-four winters of plowing northern Minnesota roads into your home. Expect plain winter know-how, safety tips that matter after fifty, and a few stories from the ditches along the way. Whether you've shoveled your whole life or this is your first real winter, pour a hot cup of coffee and stay a while.
